description: Add stage-aware ALFWorld guidance for transform-before-place tasks and prevent premature/wrong destination loops.

actions.code:
def hook(ctx, nb):
    nb['stage'] = 'find_target'
    nb['last_hint'] = ''
    nb['transform_done'] = False
    nb['placed_count'] = 0
    text = 'Follow ALFWorld order: find and take the target, do any required clean/heat/cool while carrying it, then put it at the requested destination. For two-object tasks, leave placed items and use the same destination.'
    return {'skills': [{'text': text}], 'tool_hint': 'Do not substitute a different transform or destination; do not take back an item already placed at the goal.'}
